mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (emp_id, token, expire_time, create_time) VALUES (#{empId}, #{token}, #{expireTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, emp_id, token, expire_time, revoked, create_time FROM refresh_token WHERE token = #{token} AND revoked = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked = 1 WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM refresh_token WHERE expire_time < NOW() OR revoked = 1
